decks.notes: This Jund Aggro deck focuses on efficient removal and disruption, while also utilizing powerful threats like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and graveyard synergies. With a streamlined mana base and the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring, this deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, while still being able to grind out wins with its versatile card selection and strong creature base.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful lands like Urza's Saga to search for key combo pieces like Primeval Titan. The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and create explosive turns, allowing for efficient mana acceleration. By combining land synergies with powerful creatures like Primeval Titan, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its efficient ramp and combo potential. The deck also includes utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Boseiju, Who Endures to support its game plan.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also utilizes Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's creativity comes from its ability to combo off with cards like Transmogrify and Persist, creating unexpected and powerful plays. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provides additional versatility and control options. The mana base is designed to support the deck's powerful spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient removal spells and disruption to control the board while deploying powerful threats like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It also utilizes Mishra's Bauble and Mishra's Research Desk to generate card advantage and manipulate the top of the deck. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six provides additional card advantage and land recursion, allowing the deck to grind out value over the course of a game. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support the three-color Jund archetype and maximize consistency.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful threats and overwhelming the opponent with a mix of creatures and spells that provide value. By utilizing Cascade mechanics and efficient creatures like Shardless Agent, the deck aims to flood the board with threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with spells like Force of Negation and Fury. The deck is designed to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game, ensuring that the opponent never has a chance to recover.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing efficient creatures and removal spells to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of the Companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring adds consistency and flexibility to the strategy. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf to quickly close out the game. The various utility lands and artifacts provide additional support and card advantage to keep the pressure up.

This Merfolk deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence and overwhelming the opponent with creatures. By utilizing cards like Svyelun of Sea and Sky, Master of the Pearl Trident, and Lord of Atlantis to boost the power of Merfolk creatures, this deck can quickly build up a threatening army. Additionally, disruptive cards like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper can disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for fast deployment of creatures, while Force of Negation provides protection against opponent's spells. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game and win through aggressive attacks.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, and removal options like Lightning Bolt and Terminate. It aims to pressure the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan. The deck also utilizes synergy between cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate value and maintain board presence. Additionally, it includes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice for graveyard recursion and resilience. The mana base is optimized for consistent and efficient casting of spells.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful lands and creatures, utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to create explosive combos. The goal is to assemble key pieces like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to generate massive amounts of damage. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Cavern of Souls to disrupt opponents and protect its own creatures. By utilizing synergies between lands and creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of power and efficiency.

The main concept of this Aggro - Red Deck Wins archetype is to deal fast and direct damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early on and finish them off quickly before they can stabilize. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy by providing consistent access to red mana sources for casting burn spells and creatures. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack also helps to bypass potential obstacles or gain additional reach to close out the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on utilizing creativity and combo potential to disrupt opponent's strategies and control the board. It includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity to generate value and create powerful board states. The deck also includes control elements like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect its combo pieces. Archon of Cruelty adds a disruptive element to the deck, while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recursion. The mana base is designed to support all colors needed for the deck's spells and abilities.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Dragon's Rage Channeler. It also utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly reduce its own life total to gain a powerful Death's Shadow. Additionally, the inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for powerful graveyard recursion, while cards like Drown in the Loch and Lightning Bolt provide removal options. The deck's goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm opponents and disrupt their strategy. It also includes cards like Expedition Map and Urza's Saga to search for key lands and artifacts, while Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Ineffable provide additional utility and support. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Thought-Knot Seer and Warping Wail helps to control the board and disrupt opponents' plans. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to secure a victory in the mid to late game.

This combo deck focuses on quickly equipping a Colossus Hammer to a creature, typically Puresteel Paladin or Ornithopter, to create a powerful threat early in the game. The deck uses efficient card draw and protection spells to assemble the combo pieces quickly and protect the equipped creature. Urza's Saga provides additional tutor options for finding key cards like Colossus Hammer or Shadowspear. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and powerful threat that can close out the game before the opponent has a chance to respond.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize efficient spells and creatures to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. By combining powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell with cards that can generate card advantage like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, the deck aims to control the game while also dealing damage quickly. The inclusion of Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer further enhances the aggressiveness of the deck, allowing it to close out games swiftly. The mana base ensures consistent access to the deck's key colors and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the board by utilizing a combination of removal spells and powerful planeswalkers. It also utilizes Elemental creatures and Elemental synergies to generate value and maintain board presence. The deck can disrupt opponents with counterspells, bounce effects, and removal, while also ramping up mana and card advantage. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines allows the deck to close out games quickly once it gains control of the game. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Underworld Breach in combination with various cheap spells and cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate a powerful combo effect. This allows the player to continuously play cards from their graveyard and generate significant value and advantage. By including cards like Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and disruption cards like Spell Snare and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the game while setting up the combo for a decisive win.

The main concept of this Modern Aggro deck, commonly known as Red Deck Wins, is to deal quick and consistent damage to the opponent. The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of low-cost and high-impact creatures, such as Eidolon of the Great Revel, Monastery Swiftspear, and Goblin Guide, to apply early pressure. It also includes a range of burn spells like Skullcrack, Searing Blaze, Boros Charm, Lightning Bolt, Rift Bolt, Skewer the Critics, and Lava Spike to deal direct damage to the opponent's life total. The deck is designed to maintain a fast pace and overwhelm the opponent with constant aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate value through casting spells with Cascade, using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cheat mana costs and gain tempo advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower, while utilizing cards like Prismari Command and Fire/Ice for versatility. Blood Moon is included to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Crashing Footfalls provides a consistent source of pressure. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive plays and exploiting the Cascade mechanic to outpace the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruption. By utilizing cards with Cascade abilities like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can consistently put pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation provide additional control options while cards like Endurance and Bonecrusher Giant offer flexibility and protection. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while still providing access to a variety of colors for Cascade spells.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with cascade mechanics to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can consistently cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury. The goal is to quickly flood the board with creatures and deal massive damage before the opponent can respond. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Negation and Subtlety to control the board and protect its own threats. With a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to win fast and decisively.

This deck focuses on casting cheap spells with Cascade to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. The goal is to cascade into Crashing Footfalls to create a board presence that is difficult for the opponent to deal with. The deck also includes ways to protect your board with cards like Force of Negation and Leyline Binding. By utilizing the Cascade mechanic effectively, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and close out the match quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly casting low-cost spells that have Cascade, allowing the player to cast additional spells for free. By overwhelming the opponent with a constant stream of threats and disruption, the deck aims to control the board and win the game quickly. The deck includes bounce spells like Brazen Borrower and removal spells like Dead / Gone to deal with opposing threats, while also including powerful finishers like Crashing Footfalls. The mana base is designed to support the deck's casting requirements efficiently.

The deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to copy spells for added value. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt while also utilizing Prismari Command for flexibility. The mana base includes a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent color access. Overall, the deck emphasizes creative combos and powerful creatures to overwhelm opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The focus of this deck is to use the combo of Indomitable Creativity along with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding to quickly put powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck also has control elements with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's colors and provide consistency in casting its spells. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in utilizing combo pieces to overwhelm opponents and secure victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to quickly equip the hammer for a powerful attack. The deck includes efficient creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Ornithopter to support this strategy. Using cards like Urza's Saga and Sigarda's Aid, the deck aims to quickly tutor and equip the hammer while protecting its key pieces with Giver of Runes. The deck is designed to win quickly and efficiently by setting up a lethal attack with the hammer-equipped creature.

The main idea behind this deck is to generate mana quickly and efficiently through cards like Manamorphose, Desperate Ritual, and Pentad Prism, in order to cast powerful spells such as Recross the Paths and Strike It Rich. By using these mana-building spells, the deck aims to assemble the combo of Goblin Charbelcher to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Veil of Summer and Pact of Negation to protect the combo, while utilizing cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Sea Gate Restoration to recycle key spells from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on using various cycling creatures and cards like Architects of Will to fill up the graveyard with creatures quickly. Once the graveyard is full, players can cast Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield, while also getting rid of opponents' creatures. The deck includes disruptive cards like Grief and Force of Negation to control the board and protect the combo. With careful planning and timing, players can create a powerful board presence and overwhelm their opponent with a sudden surge of creatures.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of disruption and graveyard interaction. Utilizing cards like Kroxa, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt opponents' strategies, while also deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure. Feign Death is used to protect key creatures and generate value. Thoughtseize and Terminate provide additional disruption, with Lightning Bolt for removal. The deck also includes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt mana bases. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting opponents' game plans.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Fury to apply early pressure, while disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief help to control the opponent's resources. The deck also includes recursion options such as Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Seasoned Pyromancer to maintain card advantage. With a mix of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, alongside disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, this deck aims to close out games swiftly and decisively.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to consistently apply pressure on the opponent by utilizing cheap and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with a suite of countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. Mishra's Bauble is used to enable card selection and delve for Unholy Heat, which serves as removal. The deck aims to close out games quickly by maintaining a threatening board presence and protecting its creatures with interaction. Blood Moon is included as a versatile hate card against greedy mana bases.
